themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that actively participate in and drive research processes, going beyond passive assistance.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers tools and discussions around AI that directly assist in writing, debugging, and verifying code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Explores the use of AI tools specifically designed to aid researchers in various stages of their work.

themes.name: AI chatbot research
themes.description: Investigates the use, impact, and limitations of AI chatbots in research contexts, including user interaction and information retrieval.

themes.name: AI for product management
themes.description: Highlights AI applications that support product managers in decision-making, strategy, and execution.

themes.name: AI design research
themes.description: Covers the application of AI in the design process, from initial ideation to interface generation and design system management.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Focuses on how AI is being used to evaluate and improve the usability of products and systems.

themes.name: AI summarization insights
themes.description: Explores AI's capability to condense large amounts of information into concise summaries to extract key insights.

themes.name: AI research platform
themes.description: Discusses the development and utilization of platforms that leverage AI to facilitate and accelerate research activities.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Covers AI's role in automating various aspects of software testing and quality assurance.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
